cohort: The study included 2,350,339 pregnancy records from the National Health Insurance database in Taiwan between 2001 and 2012, identifying 630 pregnancies in women with type 1 diabetes.
finding: Pregnant women with type 1 diabetes were at significantly increased risk of multiple adverse maternal and fetal outcomes compared to those without type 1 diabetes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as an adverse maternal outcome with an increased risk in pregnant women with type 1 diabetes.
